name: Ronin Dragoon
description: The ultimate left-spinning tyrant of the Zero-G era. Ronin Dragoon uses its reverse-rotation chrome wheel and vicious dragon heads to strike opponents from unexpected angles, delivering devastating upper-smash attacks.

ability.name: Reverse Dragon
ability.description: Every Attack win drains 30 TRUE HP (bypasses shields), heals Ronin Dragoon for that same 30 HP, and restores +0.5 Stamina. Each Attack win also builds one Dragon Reverse stack, up to 3, and every stack grants a permanent +12 ATK (+36 ATK at 3 stacks). On the 3rd stack DRAGON BURST fires for 35 TRUE damage and the stack counter resets to 0 — the +ATK is kept, so it charges up again.

special_move.name: Shogun Upper Smash
special_move.description: Rides the slope of the Zero-G stadium to drop down on the opponent with a four-hit dragon barrage at 26 damage each, 104 total.
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Shogun Upper Smash** — The left-spinning dragon roars!
💥 Cruel chrome blades lift the opponent clean off the stadium floor!
